title: Nimt.ai
tldr: AI search analytics — track brand visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity & Gemini.
description: Led the frontend development of an AI search analytics platform that helps brands track their visibility, sentiment, and citations across major LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Took initiative to restructure the existing codebase upon joining, improving maintainability and laying a stronger foundation for future development. Drove a strong focus on user experience, ensuring complex AI-driven data - such as brand sentiment scores, source tracking, and cross-model visibility rankings - was presented in a clear and intuitive way. Spearheaded the full rebrand and rebuilt the marketing site from the ground up using Framer.

title: Savery.ai
tldr: Autonomous software development platform powered by collaborating AI agents.
description: Savery is a platform for autonomous software development. It delivers high-quality end-to-end developed software. The Savery AI agent network handles end-to-end development.

title: Solkoll
tldr: CMS and document platform for solar panel installers — built as sole developer.
description: As the sole developer and maintainer of the application, I was responsible for designing and implementing intuitive user interfaces and innovative features, including interactive document functionality, a string layout builder, and PDF generation capabilities.

title: hivemalmo.se
tldr: Student-run org connecting university students with local businesses in Malmö.
description: I created a dedicated webpage my start-up, HIVE Malmö, an organization run by students, for students. Our goal is to build strong bridges that bring together students and businesses, driving the industry forward collectively.

title: bingy.se
tldr: Movie discovery app — browse, search, and curate personalized movie lists.
description: I developed a dynamic web application that allows users to browse and create personalized lists of movies. The project aims to enhance the movie-watching experience by providing a convenient platform to discover new films.

title: Pharty
tldr: Live party photo wall — guests upload photos, displayed with personalized messages.
description: For my daughter's birthday, I created a web application that allows guests to login and upload candid photos during the party. The photos are then displayed on a wall of photos, each along with a personalized message from the birthday girl.
